text: At its meeting on March 29, 30 and 31, 2023, City Council considered Item MM5.1 and requested OMERS to make a presentation to the Infrastructure and Environment Committee on a climate strategy. At its meeting of September 20, 2023, the Infrastructure and Environment Committee considered item IE6.1 and invited OMERS to make an annual presentation to Infrastructure and Environment Committee on the OMERS Climate Action Plan. The Infrastructure and Environment Committee will receive an update from the Chair of the OMERS Administration Corporation Board of Directors, the Vice President, Sustainable Investing, OMERS, and the Associate Director, Global Sustainable Investing and Operations, Oxford Properties, on the OMERS Climate Action Plan, including progress achieved to date.
The Infrastructure and Environment Committee: 1. Received the presentation from OMERS for information.
